name: Navaro
shortDescription: UK venue-management software for community spaces, including church halls, with bookings, invoices and client records.
suitableContexts: Churches hiring out a hall or several bookable spaces
Volunteer-led venues that need bookings, invoices and clear staff access

pricing.summary: Navaro publishes monthly and annual plan structures based on venue, space and booking limits, but the public page reviewed did not display all current monthly prices consistently. A 25% charity discount and a 30-day trial are advertised.

tiers.label: Starter
tiers.detail: One venue, two spaces and up to 75 bookings per month

tiers.label: Pro
tiers.detail: Up to three venues, ten spaces and 500 bookings per month

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.detail: Up to ten venues, 25 spaces and 1,500 bookings per month

pricing.trialDetails: A 30-day trial without a card is advertised.

gdprInformation: Navaro publishes UK GDPR-focused terms and a privacy policy. Its terms say account data is retained for 90 days after inactivity following cancellation; churches should review the current data-processing arrangements for their own use.
integrations: Calendar and accounting integrations are described by the supplier
importExport: CSV exports for bookings, clients and reports
support: Published support response targets vary by plan

uk-purchasing.value: Navaro's terms name D&M Nexus Inc. Ltd, a UK-registered company, and its pricing and terms are presented in GBP.

data-processing.value: Supplier publishes a privacy policy and terms referring to UK GDPR, retention after cancellation, export and deletion tools.

editorial.assessment: Navaro is a general venue-management product, not a church-management database, but its village-hall workflow may be relevant where hall hire is an important part of church operations. It combines booking, client and invoice administration in one platform. Churches should trial a real hire journey, including permissions, safeguarding-sensitive notes and cancellation handling.
bestFor: Churches or parishes managing community-hall hire
Venues with several rooms, recurring hirers and volunteer administrators
Teams wanting invoices and booking administration alongside a public availability workflow
strengths: Published UK company identity and public service terms
Supplier describes village-hall use and a charity discount
Booking, invoicing, client records and staff access are part of one product
limitations: It is not presented as church-specific software
Confirm the current displayed plan price and any payment fees before buying
Review access, sensitive-note handling, data-processing documentation and cancellation workflow against the church's own policies

procurementVerdict.problem: Churches with substantial hall or room-hire administration
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Venue, booking, client and invoice workflows are combined in a newer UK platform
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a realistic recurring hire, cancellation, invoice and staff-permission test during the trial

sources.label: Companies House: D&M Nexus Inc. Ltd

seo.description: Independent Navaro profile for UK churches: hall and room bookings, invoices, charity pricing and data-processing checks.
